name: Code Block
when_to_pick: Show actual code the reader can copy and run — MQL4/5 expert-advisor snippets, TradingView Pine Script, Python ccxt order placement, a webhook payload, a CLI command. Use for a focused excerpt (a function, a loop, a config), not a whole file; long programs belong in a gist. The polished header carries a language chip + optional filename; readers get a one-click copy button, and optional line numbers help you reference specific lines in the surrounding prose.

language.description: Language label shown in the header chip, e.g. 'pine', 'python', 'mql5', 'javascript', 'bash', 'json'. Displayed uppercase.

filename.description: Optional file/context name shown beside the language chip, e.g. 'rsi_reversion.pine' or 'webhook.json'.

code.description: The raw source to display. Newlines (\n) separate lines; tabs are rendered. Auto-escaped — do not pass HTML.

show_line_numbers.description: Render a gutter of line numbers (default false). Turn on when the prose references specific lines.

caption.description: Optional one-line takeaway shown under the block, e.g. what the snippet does or the key idea to notice.
